summary.note: HTTP pull ingest and an HTTPS cache work end to end; push and low-latency ingest, PATCH and caching rules missing; geo-fencing and URL signing accepted but not enforced; client plays DASH only.
No templates, transcoding, packaging or encryption.
No uplink anywhere; an UPLINK provisioning session silently behaves as downlink.
AF can request a Delivery Boost from the PCF, but no client asks for it; no bit rate recommendation.
Policy Templates provisioned and accepted without checks; no client uses them; Rel-19 L4S, QoS monitoring and slices absent.
Works end to end into local AF files; the required final report is never sent when no interval is set.
One scheme (QM10), 8 metrics, two wrong names, wrong Content-Type on both sides, local files only.
Runs through a 5G-MAG pipeline (player, AS, cmcd-toolkit), not provisioning or M3d; player v1, AS neither edition, toolkit a mix.
Absent; integration of the Data Collection AF is in progress; the AS R4 role is missing.
Absent; CMMF work is in progress, not yet merged (Content Delivery Protocols).
No DRM or CPIX in client or AS.
Release 17 specifies no M3 API (TS 26.512 V17.10.0, clause 9); the AF and AS use /3gpp-m3/v1. The Release 19 Mas_Configuration API is absent.

M5 in Release 17 form only. M6 and M7 are partly implemented as an Android binding: M7 covers the core playback path, but seek and reset are stubs and several status values use other units. TS 26.510 services absent.
PCF and BSF over N5 via 5G Core Service Consumers; NEF (N33) absent.

layers: summary: one row per feature cluster (status per component and release, rolled up from findings); findings: the per-requirement evidence underneath. Shared base APIs (Provisioning Sessions, Service Access Information, Content Protocols Discovery) count only under Content hosting and Media session handling; rows tagged R17/R19 count under R17. endToEnd: a feature works end to end only if no owning component lacks it (any absent owner makes it absent).
